title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta14

## Prewarmed, reusable map render resources

This beta implements the backend foundation for a lighter Map Card without changing mowing data, confirmed cycle/reset ownership, MQTT live tails, Schedule, gates or History archives.

- Prewarm current-cycle render artifacts from coordinator observations, using one coalescing background builder per mower shared by all cards.
- Serve repeated legacy current-cycle requests from the prepared cache. Cold/dirty legacy requests share one publication instead of duplicating rendering; their existing response schema is retained.
- Skip loading History archives entirely when all mapped zones already have vendor-owned geometry.
- Add the opt-in, ready-only `artifacts_only=1` Map API manifest with small per-zone descriptors and no raw points or SVG paths.
- Expose each prepared zone as a separate authenticated, versioned SVG alpha-mask resource. Unchanged zones keep the same resource ID and bytes across updates to another zone and across restarts.
- Support private ETag/304 revalidation. Validate current zone/cycle ownership before conditional responses; resources from reset cycles return 410 rather than reviving cached geometry.
- Retain at most two prepared resource revisions per current zone for in-flight same-cycle browser requests. No public/anonymous endpoints or new runtime dependencies.
- Include passive cache diagnostics: build/cache-hit counts, coalesced updates, build duration, prepared zone count and byte size.
- Keep presentation freshness aware of completed background publications, so existing cards can discover late/retried renders.

Map Card 0.3.7-beta7 remains compatible and benefits from backend prewarming/cache reuse. It does not yet consume the new per-zone resource protocol; that needs a companion card update. This release deliberately retains SVG, not PNG/WebP, and does not simplify or discard source geometry. Browser-specific performance gains must still be measured in field use.

The regressions cover cache reuse, concurrent callers, slow builds, per-zone isolation, coalescing, cycle resets during rendering, width/map changes, restart restoration, failure backoff, unload, MQTT/History fallback and real aiohttp conditional responses. See `docs/MAP_ARTIFACTS.md` for the additive API contract.
